story: In Czech Tour Stage 3 2026, an early 6-rider break gained a 2:15 lead but was caught. Jan Castellon and Tarozzi attacked with 12 km remaining, neutralized by the peloton. Geoffrey Bouchard and Kamiel Bonneau formed a late duo but were reeled in by Ineos. Andrew August launched a final km attack, winning a sprint against Fancellu and extending his GC lead.
